Usage: aeat app ledger import [OPTIONS]

  Import bank statements or records into the accounting ledger

Options:
  --file <path>                   Path to the bank statement file or directory
                                  [required]
  --provider <auto|csv|ofx|qfx|xlsx|excel|n26|pdf|pdf-n26>
                                  Statement format provider. Recognised
                                  values: {providers}  [required]
  --dry-run                       Run the import in dry-run mode (without
                                  saving)
  --verify                        Verify entries after import
  --verify-source <path>          Original file used to verify imported rows.
  --verbose                       Show detailed information during import
  --period <str>                  Filing period as an AEAT token: 1T-4T
                                  (quarters), 0A (annual), 01-12 (months).
                                  Combine with --year to choose the year.
  --year <int>                    Filing year for --period (e.g. 2024).
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
